gaps.explanation: The General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p5) itemizes only the General Government departments (actual sum 1,557,669, all in detail; its 'Miscellaneous' row prints '-') but its printed TOTAL DISBURSEMENTS is 6,698,247; the other General Fund functions are not itemized on the schedule and are missing from detail. The governmental funds statement General Fund column (p4) prints them: Public Safety 3,264,111 + Public Works 60,757 + Public Assistance 41,533 + Miscellaneous 1,506,522 + Capital Outlay 267,656 = 5,140,579 (General Fund Total 6,698,247 = General Government 1,557,668 + 5,140,579). Arithmetic: 6,479,377 + 5,140,579 = 11,619,956 vs statement 11,619,955 (difference 1 = the report's own rounding, schedule General Government 1,557,669 vs statement 1,557,668).
